messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] limit effective parameters in spatial model?
parts:
> result=inla(formula12,family="zeroinflated.nbinomial.2",data=habitat2,E=.7,

I think you need E = rep(0.7, n), but I'm am not sure.

> inla.expectation(function(x) 1/x^.5,result$marginals[[1]])

there is not object result$marginals, its divided into

result$marginals.fixed
result$marginals.random
result$marginals.linear.predictor (if you have requested them),

say, like

> n = 10
> y = rnorm(n)
> i = 1:n
> r = inla(y ~ 1 + f(i, model="iid"), data = data.frame(y,i))
> r$marginals.fixed$'(Intercept)'
> r$marginals.random$i[[1]]
> r$marginals.random$i[[n]]
